goal: Add a QMS-TR page (route /qms-tr, copy of the existing MTR module), keep the existing MTR page (route /mtr) as the equivalent duplicate, and add a Macrocac placeholder page for the on-demand publish-to-productive-SQL-tables process.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new 'qmstr' module exists at route /qms-tr labeled 'QMS-TR', registered in registry.ts, with page heading 'QMS-TR' and the same country-grid content as MTR.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Navigate to /ms-process-app/qms-tr in Playwright; assert h1 text 'QMS-TR' and the country cards render.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The existing MTR page is still reachable at /mtr labeled 'MTR' with heading 'MTR' (unchanged), serving as the duplicate equal to QMS-TR.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Navigate to /ms-process-app/mtr; assert h1 text 'MTR' and the same country-grid renders.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new 'macrocac' placeholder module exists at route /macrocac labeled 'Macrocac' in the Pipeline group, rendering a complete 'coming soon' page describing the on-demand upload of results to productive SQL Server tables.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Navigate to /ms-process-app/macrocac; assert h1 text 'Macrocac' and the descriptive placeholder copy is present.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Both new nav items appear in the sidebar and are clickable; no orphan routes.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: In Playwright, assert sidebar links 'QMS-TR' and 'Macrocac' exist and navigation works.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Build is green: lint, typecheck and unit tests pass.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm run lint && npm run build (tsc) && npm test.

tasks.desc: Copy src/modules/mtr -> src/modules/qmstr; rename index.ts (id qmstr, label QMS-TR, route /qms-tr) and page to QmsTrPage with heading 'QMS-TR'.
Create src/modules/macrocac placeholder module (id macrocac, route /macrocac, Pipeline group) with a complete coming-soon page.
Register qmstrModule and macrocacModule in registry.ts; add config keys to useModuleConfig and public/config.js; add PATH_ICONS entries.
Verify: lint + typecheck + tests + Playwright walkthrough.
